writer.kind: native exact full rewrite from final body

optimizer.update_order: checkerboard 0 then 1; strict negative local field product
optimizer.weight: half the sum of recipient directed normalized absolute edge weights
optimizer.candidates: all initial and final states; minimum math.fsum disagreement; ties lexicographic sign bits
optimizer.free_components: smallest-index node positive in any constraint component without pinned nodes

cohort.selection: All 63 prior precision-panel records without selection on continuation, repair or repair benefit. The complete previous natural futures are exposed; this is development on selected historical boundaries.

action.time: Once on the g14 packet, before g15 and before any new injury or forcing is observed.
action.method: Existing recipient-only sign-graph completion, unchanged; 16 starts, at most 64 sweeps, seed 2026101004.
action.support: Fill exactly zero edges with the median absolute nonzero incoming magnitude times inferred node-sign products. Preserve all nonzero bytes; an empty packet stays empty.
action.subsequent: No further repairs. Both arms undergo every native full rewrite and propagate their own outgoing state after failures.

future.endpoint: Task-aligned terminal fresh-body success after 18 inherited rewrites; all four last-32-frame means strictly greater than .25.
future.coupling: Per key and generation, both arms share precisely the same injury, birth and noise. Noise regimes share base draws; matched copies cue0 into cue1 and independent retains both. Each branch propagates its own outputs.
future.seed: First16 bytes SHA256(compact JSON [namespace,stage,*key,generation,purpose,channel]), interpreted little endian, PCG64.

analysis.target: Delta(z,a)=E[Y_H(repair_once)-Y_H(no_repair)|z]; paired binary difference is rescue minus harm.
analysis.primary: Equal acquisition-block, then equal current-expression-class weight over the selected panel. One mean net terminal repair benefit per noise regime.
analysis.prediction: Positive average net benefit of once-only graph completion in both noise regimes is a development hypothesis motivated by earlier repair studies.
analysis.interval: Mean +/- t(.975,B-1)*sample block SD/sqrt(B), descriptive with only 16 blocks. All block values retained. Zero sample SD does not license certainty and receives UNRESOLVED.
analysis.signal: For nonzero block SD: lower>0 yields POSITIVE_SIGNAL, upper<0 NEGATIVE_SIGNAL, otherwise UNRESOLVED. Both regimes positive required for joint positive signal; any negative yields CONTRARY_SIGNAL; otherwise UNRESOLVED. No confirmatory or RDT-specific verdict.
secondary: weighted rescue, harm, both-pass and neither-pass frequencies with unweighted counts
current-expression and all history diagnostics, no rescue of primary
mean benefit in five fixed risk bins [0,.2,.4,.6,.8,1], separately for all three frozen predictors, no fitting or scheduler evaluation
all three frozen predictors: control-outcome Brier, original paired block gain intervals and calibration; secondary only
analysis.coupling_limit: Mean treatment effect does not depend on the chosen valid coupling; rescue/harm decomposition does. One paired future does not identify a precise individual conditional effect.

costs.shared_costs: Boundary acquisition and transfer, fitting and prediction arithmetic are not free; retain previous historical costs separately. Native probe count ratio is not a wall-time ratio. Repair intervention and audit CPU recorded separately.

audit.flat: One key-only hash-min record per block in each regime, both arms, all nineteen reads. Flat path propagates its own outputs. Byte-exact bodies, windows and writer output.
audit.repair: Every repair compared with separate Prim/flat optimizer and independent support/magnitude construction.
audit.independent_analysis: Separate scalar weighted net benefits, all event counts, diagnostics and confidence calculations.
audit.barrier: Verify entire cache, prepare and audit all repair actions, then seal all records, branch input hashes and frozen forecasts before any future.

scope: Assay and development evidence about externally supplied ordinary graph correction; no learned benefit predictor, optimal budget policy, new-founder generalization, external preregistration or RDT-specific mechanism.
